A card: the plan of the kept layout as its thumbnail (decision 6: 320 by 180 in its own units, scaled across the card on surface-2; every card here shows the demo's plan, since the data holds no layout of the other two), the name in text-title, the roof's words in text-caption, the capacity and the energy as a stat pair in mono, “Edited …” in text-caption text-3. A press on the card opens the design.

The menu button of 32 stands at the top right of the card, over the thumbnail; its list is the switcher's: rows of 44 with an icon of 18 and a fact at the right, 240 wide, 6 under the button. Duplicate makes “Copy of Pune demo roof” and opens it; Save a copy is the .rtd of Phase 9; Delete asks (decision 7). The second card has no numbers: before a system voltage it says what waits. The third has not run: “Not run yet”; a value that cannot exist yet is absent with its reason (guidelines.md), never 0.

Delete Pune demo roof?

It is kept on this device alone.

The question is the data's, word for word: the first sentence as the title, the second as the body. Cancel is the quiet action and takes the focus first, so that Enter by mistake does no harm; Delete is the primary one. On phone the dialog is a bottom sheet with Delete on top (components.md, “Dialog”). Nothing is lost without a word (D32).

Rename

Desktop: a card renamed in place, the name as a text field with the caret
Pune demo roof, block B90 × 40 m flat industrial roof
Capacity357.28 kWpEnergy, year 1617.8 MWh
Edited 2 hours ago

Rename turns the name into the text field of components.md, across the card, 40 high (44 on touch), with the focus: accent border and the halo. Enter or leaving the field commits the name, trimmed, 200 characters at most; Escape gives the name of before back; an empty name is not committed and the field says “A name is needed” under itself.

The committed name is the design's everywhere at once: the card, the switcher, the top bar, the file name of every download.

“This design” is the demo edited and kept: the tick in accent, “Saved on this device” with its dot, and Rename. “On this device” lists the designs kept here, newest first, rows of 44: the name, and under it the capacity in mono where a run has come, else the roof's words. The fact stands under the name rather than at its right, since the names and the roof's words are long and the panel is 340. The open design carries the tick; a press on another row opens it.

Open a project is live now (Phase 10, step 9). On phone and tablet the switcher is a bottom sheet over the dimmed screen, the state of saving said here only.

The words are the plan's (decision 3): a design is saved 600 ms after the last committed edit and says Saving, then Saved; the demo is not kept until it is edited, then it is a design named “Pune demo roof” like any other; a failure says Not saved and opens the notes with the words. On tablet and phone the state is said in the project switcher only. Under the card: the top bar of the Studio at its width of 1440 with each state in its place.
